label: copy-phase input c, early-middle in the copy (orig position 2-3), not near the end
explanation: Token-specific feature: fires only in the copy phase when the fed-back input is the letter c (98% of activation mass; essentially never on other tokens, never in the original or delimiter phase, and only on repeated occurrences i.e. the c being re-read). Magnitude depends on where the c sits: strongest when c was original token 2 or 3 (recall_idx 3-4) in long sequences (L 8-9) with several outputs still to go; weak or absent when c is the first original token, near the end of the copy (to_go 0-1), or in short sequences (L<=5 never fires). The plain c-in-copy predicate has mass recall 0.98 but precision 0.17; the position conditions raise F1 to ~0.64, still leaving many inactive c steps in shorter sequences.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token (most: c, i, v, l, 0, x; least: 1, p, q, g) and the token being output (most: 0, i, c, f, a, x; least: p, r, -, k); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=3, t=12, L=9 & t=12.
